steps.text: Open a detail view for an ai_reconstructed route on device.

assertion.reason: Requires Founder-Operator on a real iOS device against the real un-seeded post-Sprint-04 rider-ready catalog. Caption copy, route line rendering, and calm-context judgment are human observations. Simulator/automation evidence is explicitly invalid per the FO omission record.

steps.text: Confirm the caption reads as plain informational text.

assertion.reason: Subjective human judgment: caption tone (calm-context vs warning); requires the founder's first-impression gut-check on a real device. No machine-verifiable assertion.

steps.text: Confirm muted styling with no badge or warning affordance.

assertion.reason: Requires real-device visual inspection of text color, weight, badge/chip presence, border, and warning affordance. Simulator rendering may differ from device.

steps.text: Check the caption in both light and dark mode.

assertion.reason: Requires iOS appearance toggle (Settings > Display & Brightness > Dark) and re-opening the detail view. Two screenshots required (light + dark). Simulator theme switching may not perfectly match device behavior.

steps.text: Confirm a scraped_promoted route shows no caption.

assertion.reason: Requires locating a scraped_promoted route on the real catalog and confirming zero caption nodes on the detail surface. Human visual confirmation required.

steps.text: Browse a thin region; confirm the honest 'no routes near you yet' state.

assertion.reason: Requires setting device location to a thin-coverage region (0 nearby rider-ready routes), browsing discovery, and human confirmation of the literal 'no routes near you yet' copy, absence of '0mi' pills, and labeled fallback-to-national. Requires real catalog Convex backend.

steps.text: Confirm a saved non-ready route still opens its detail.

assertion.reason: Requires having a saved non-rider-ready route in the founder's real Saved library, tapping it, and confirming the detail view opens with the honest 'Approximate location' state. Gate-independent reachability is a visual confirmation on a real device.
